title: Extension by zero and restriction on a localized site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a Grothendieck site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $W$ be an object. Give the slice $\mathcal C/W$ the localized topology, with coverings those whose underlying families cover in $\mathcal C$. The restriction functor $j_W^*:\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C/W)$, $G\mapsto G|_W$, has a left adjoint $j_{W!}$ (extension by zero), and $j_{W!}$ is exact. The restriction functor $j_W^*$ is exact as well [def-sp-abelian].

source.place: Modules on Sites, Section 03DH and Lemmas 03DI (lemma-extension-by-zero) and 03DJ (lemma-extension-by-zero-exact), specialized to abelian sheaves

proof.text: The localized topology on the slice $\mathcal C/W$ is the topology specified in the statement, and restriction $G\mapsto G|_W$ is the sheaf obtained by evaluating $G$ on the underlying object of each map $V\to W$; these are the standard localized-site constructions.

source.place: Sites, Section 00XZ (section-localize), localized site and restriction

proof.text: The left adjoint $j_{W!}$ exists and satisfies the natural adjunction bijection with $j_W^*$ by [lem-weil-pbc-site-restriction-adjunction].

The extension-by-zero functor $j_{W!}$ is exact by [lem-weil-pbc-site-extension-by-zero-exact], so it carries every short exact sequence of abelian sheaves on $\mathcal C/W$ to a short exact sequence on $\mathcal C$.

The restriction functor $j_W^*$ is exact by [lem-weil-pbc-site-restriction-exact], so it carries every short exact sequence of abelian sheaves on $\mathcal C$ to a short exact sequence on $\mathcal C/W$.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma 03DJ (lemma-extension-by-zero-exact), restriction assertion
